content: Webpay Plus flow verified against two official Transbank artifacts (docs page + transbank-sdk-python source): create(buy_order, session_id, amount, return_url) returns token (5-min validity) + redirect URL; after payment Webpay redirects GET to return_url with token_ws; merchant must immediately commit(token); approved iff response_code==0 and status==AUTHORIZED; merchant shows own voucher (amount, buy order, auth code, last 4 digits, date). Cancel/timeout/error param combos: normal=token_ws only; timeout=TBK_ID_SESION+TBK_ORDEN_COMPRA; user cancel=TBK_TOKEN+TBK_ID_SESION+TBK_ORDEN_COMPRA; form error=all four. status(token) queryable up to 7 days; refund(token, amount) and capture exist in SDK but deferred capture is out of scope. SPA must handle redirect landing outside React Router.
